panel.name: aliases_panel
panel.panel.string: No aliases. Use Add... to name a folder.
An alias's name is letters, digits, - _ and . -- not self, and not starting sl-.

text.name: aliases_label
text.tool_tip: A SLua script reaches a library on disk through an alias: require("@name/module") reads module from the alias's folder, where no .luaurc names the alias. A script in an object reaches a library on disk only this way.
